group_a_llm_sentiment_config.note: Daily market-level LLM sentiment features are merged into Group A shared market state and also drive a sentiment risk gate that can neutralize 00631L or enable 00632R defense.

group_a_sentiment_gate_config.note: LLM sentiment can optionally boost 00631L on positive days, zero 00631L on risk-off days, and force a 00632R defensive floor on severe days.

group_a_hard_crash_gate_config.note: Group A hard crash gate is disabled.

group_a_local_regime_gate_config.note: Group A local regime gate uses early 0050 and TWSE trend / drawdown / momentum signals to switch from the primary PPO output into defensive templates with hysteresis.

group_a_institutional_config.normalization: rolling net-buy shares divided by rolling traded volume
group_a_institutional_config.note: Group A institutional features are per-ticker TWSE T86 net-buy ratios for foreign, investment trust, dealer, and total institutional flow.

group_a_margin_config.level_normalization: daily balances divided by corresponding TWSE margin limits
group_a_margin_config.flow_normalization: 5-day net margin/short flow divided by 5-day traded volume
group_a_margin_config.note: Group A margin features are disabled.

group_a_margin_shared_config.aggregation: sum daily TWSE margin and short balances/flows across the Group A ETF basket
group_a_margin_shared_config.level_normalization: aggregate balances divided by aggregate TWSE limits
group_a_margin_shared_config.flow_normalization: 5-day aggregate net margin/short flow divided by 5-day aggregate traded volume
group_a_margin_shared_config.growth_signal: 252-day rolling z-score of 20-day aggregate margin balance growth
group_a_margin_shared_config.source: duckdb margin_data aggregated across Group A tickers
group_a_margin_shared_config.note: Group A shared margin regime features are disabled.

group_a_market_margin_shared_config.aggregation: TWSE full-market daily margin data aggregated across all securities in market_margin_data
group_a_market_margin_shared_config.level_normalization: market aggregate balances divided by market aggregate TWSE limits
group_a_market_margin_shared_config.flow_normalization: 5-day net margin or short flow divided by 5-day average prior balance
group_a_market_margin_shared_config.growth_signal: 252-day rolling z-score of 20-day market aggregate balance growth
group_a_market_margin_shared_config.note: Group A market-level margin regime features are disabled.

group_a_market_margin_gate_config.note: Group A market margin gate is disabled.

group_b_sentiment_gate_config.note: Sentiment gate is disabled because Group B LLM sentiment is disabled.

group_a_pva_sigmoid_config.note: Group A PVA/SJM uses continuous risk scaling on 00631L, can redeploy stressed budget into 0050, boosts S-state overlays on high-drift days, and only uses short-duration 00632R hedging in M state.

group_a_inverse_hedge_config.note: 00632R is treated as a short hedge and is forcibly exited when M state ends or max holding days is reached.

execution_timing.note: Signals use day-t data, trades execute at next trading day's open, and performance is marked at next close.

group_a_dca_config.note: Group A DCA is applied only during evaluation/backtest, not PPO training reward.

group_a_dividend_config.note: Group A dividends are credited on ex-dividend day and immediately reinvested by current portfolio weights.
